notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
ACTION PACKED NEW EVENT!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33090910/69c9b15ee1e27e6a42166c74dc1a6671dd9d17f0.png[/img]

We’ve received intel that ICEFALL, a new threat, has been operating in the Siberian Tundra. Grab your rifle and prepare for Arctic Warfare! 

Take on new enemies and expand your armory in our latest event, COLD WAR! 

Do you have the luck of the Irish?

Join us this March for awesome St Patrick’s Day celebrations! With hidden targets to find, new gear to unlock and 7 days of rewards to enjoy, what’s not to like? 

The festivities start March 11th, don’t miss out!
